BP.label: Business Plan
BP.limit_source: template: "The core section should ideally not exceed 15 pages, with 20 pages as a maximum"

sections.name: Executive Summary
sections.limit_source: template: "Describe in simple words in a maximum of 1 page (!)"

IP.label: Incubation Proposal
IP.limit_source: template: "Please limit this Incubation Proposal to maximum 10 pages including cover page and any annexes"

required_text.why: the Declaration of Minimal Financial Assistance page

must_not_be_blank.pattern: Date or period of MFA subsidy received:(?P<value>[^\n]*)\n

forbidden.why: "Complaint" (Board #85 typo for "Compliant"; if you really mean a complaint, reword)

forbidden.pattern: which you should have known|not a customer which|\bnote to (self|team)\b|\b(TODO|TBD|XXX|FIXME)\b|lorem ipsum

review.why: MoU/LoI mentioned: claim only what is signed; 'in progress' is not a partnership
'partner' wording: check each named partner against the answer bank's do-not-claim list
'customer' wording: pre-revenue; only named customers who agreed may be called customers
readiness claim: must match the answer bank status lines word for word

checks: Costs: one line per sub-task with each cost shown, not consolidated per task (Board #85).
Incentive: total within £51,724.00; no more than 50% (£25,862.00) on office rental, spend outside the UK and entrepreneur salaries (Incubation Proposal template).
MFA: total of declared MFA plus this award stays under £315,000 (Cover Letter template).
Fonts: "Don't change or reduce the font size" (templates) — compare against the template by eye.
Every number traces to the answer bank or is labelled as an assumption; product status lines match the answer bank word for word.
Tell the Edinburgh Programme Manager in advance about any support or reasonable adjustments needed.
